lines.zh: 我晃着飞，不知要去哪里。
lines.en: I drift along, not knowing where I go.

lines.zh: 黑色的身子在水汽里一闪。
lines.en: My black body glints through the mist.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇得很慢，像在打瞌睡。
lines.en: My wings beat slowly, as if half asleep.

lines.zh: 我沿着光的边缘绕一圈。
lines.en: I trace one circle along the edge of the light.

lines.zh: 那边的石头在响，我过去看看。
lines.en: The stones are clicking over there; I go look.
My black is not deep — it is just right.

lines.zh: 我飞一段，又忘了为什么飞。
lines.en: I fly a while, then forget why I flew.

lines.zh: 风把我推歪，我顺势拐弯。
lines.en: The wind pushes me off course, so I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我在异位的空地上打转。
lines.en: I circle over the empty ground of the Otherside.

lines.zh: 光从我身上滑过去，不留痕。
lines.en: Light slides off me and leaves no mark.

lines.zh: 我飘过一块发紫的石头。
lines.en: I drift past a stone glowing violet.
There is a path ahead, or perhaps not.

lines.zh: 我飞得不快，够我看清地面。
lines.en: I fly slowly enough to see the ground.
Who called me? Let me pause.

lines.zh: 我飞过一片黑水，没照出影子。
lines.en: I cross black water without casting a shadow.

lines.zh: 翅膀一顿，我就往下沉了。
lines.en: One pause of my wings and I sink lower.

lines.zh: 我缩成一粒暗色的光点。
lines.en: I shrink into a dim fleck of light.

lines.zh: 停着的时候，我几乎看不见。
lines.en: At rest, I am nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 我想不起自己是哪天出现的。
lines.en: I do not remember hatching from anything at all.

lines.zh: 十五点血，不算多也不算少。
lines.en: Fifteen hit points — not much, not little.

lines.zh: 我的黑色是恰到好处的。
lines.en: My black is exactly as it should be.

lines.zh: 这里的光很冷，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The light here is cold; I dislike it.
I count the grey specks drifting past.
Folded wings, and my glow shrinks.

lines.zh: 我好像忘了什么重要的事。
lines.en: I seem to have forgotten something important.

lines.zh: 空地上什么也没有，正好。
lines.en: There is nothing on the empty ground — good.
I hang myself in the middle of the air.

lines.zh: 注魔石在我身体里发沉。
lines.en: The infusion stone sits heavy inside me.
You can see me? I am so dim.

lines.zh: 你眼里有光，我认出来了。
lines.en: There is light in your eyes; I know it.
Through which door did you come in?

lines.zh: 你身上没有异位的味道。
lines.en: You do not smell of the Otherside.
Do not shine a torch at me; it is too bright.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛跟着我这一粒黑。
lines.en: Your eyes follow this one black speck.
You walk so straight — how strange.
Your shadow is as dim as I am.
Have you come to take my infusion stone?

lines.zh: 再站一会儿，我还没看清。
lines.en: Stand a while longer; I have not seen enough.
My light was struck apart.
It hurts; I shrink to a dot.

lines.zh: 这一击把我的黑色打淡了。
lines.en: That blow thinned my black.
Whoever touches me sends my light wild.

lines.zh: 我十五点生命，不够挨打。
lines.en: Fifteen hit points are not enough for a beating.
I drift higher to get away from you.
A split opened in my wing.
Another small patch of my dim glow goes out.
I am keeping count of this.

lines.zh: 别打了，我快聚不起来了。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I can barely gather myself.

lines.zh: 你手里那点亮，给我看看。
lines.en: Show me that little glow in your hand.
I do not eat; I only want light.
That stone is warm; I lean closer.

lines.zh: 你的火把跳一下，我跟着晃。
lines.en: Your torch flickers, and I sway with it.
Lower the light; then I can reach it.

lines.zh: 我闻到了注魔石的味道。
lines.en: I smell infusion stone on the air.
You put the light away, and I withdraw.
Bright things always make me stop.

lines.zh: 让我贴着这块石头暖一会儿。
lines.en: Let me warm myself against this stone a moment.
That light is mine; give it back.
You scattered my glow.

lines.zh: 你把我撞得转了个整圈。
lines.en: The collision tumbled my dim little body over.
This speck of me — light, is it not?
Back off; my wing is bent.
You passed through me; something went cold.

lines.zh: 别碰，我很难重新聚起来。
lines.en: Do not touch me; I am slow to gather again.
One bump, and my black fades.
I drift half a block aside to make way.
Your armor is far too hard.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，重新飞稳。
lines.en: I shake my wings and steady myself again.

lines.zh: 两粒暗光在空地上碰头。
lines.en: Two dim lights meet on the empty ground.

lines.zh: 我们绕成一个很小的圈。
lines.en: We circle into a very small ring.

lines.zh: 光不传给别人，只在这里。
lines.en: The light passes only between us.

lines.zh: 我们的黑挨在一起，更暗了。
lines.en: Our blacks touch and grow darker.
It flew off, but the light remains.

lines.zh: 这块空地又能多两粒光。
lines.en: This ground can hold two more lights.
We make no sound; the light speaks.

lines.zh: 靠得近了，就分不清谁是谁。
lines.en: Close together, we cannot tell each other apart.
I remember its brightness for a long time.

lines.zh: 明天它还会来这块石头。
lines.en: Tomorrow it will come to this stone again.

lines.zh: 我捞起一粒会亮的东西。
lines.en: I scoop up a small shining thing.
I carry this pebble in my mouth as I fly.
I picked up the broken light you dropped.
It was so heavy I nearly fell.
I hide the light beneath my wings.

lines.zh: 这块不像注魔石，可也亮。
lines.en: This is not infusion stone, but it shines.
I carried it around three times.
Someone else's thing — I keep it for now.

lines.zh: 我的怀里只装得下一粒。
lines.en: Only one fleck fits in my hold.
If it falls, it falls; I will find another.
You stepped in, so I have fixed on you.
This empty ground does not welcome the living.
My glow tightens, ready to sting.
You came to the wrong place; go back.
I have locked onto your shadow.
You carry a torch; you are too easy to see.
This time I will not drift in circles.

lines.zh: 你拿了注魔石，我看到了。
lines.en: You took an infusion stone; I saw it.
There is one path, and I block it.
I rise a little to see you clearly.

lines.zh: 暗光聚起来，是动手前兆。
lines.en: My dim light gathers — the sign before a strike.
Even a small speck bites; remember that.
I circle you, in no hurry.
A thread of light shows at my black edge.
You raise your hand, and I slip aside.
I am tallying every blink you make.
The stone under your foot will click.
I come a little closer, then retreat.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸变浅了，你要动手。
lines.en: Your breathing has gone shallow; you are about to strike.
The light is gathering; it will soon be enough.

lines.zh: 你一动，身后的光就偏了。
lines.en: You moved, and the light behind you shifted.
That step was too quick of you.
My shadow has stretched an inch.

lines.zh: 眨一次眼，我就换个方向。
lines.en: Blink once and I take a new angle.

lines.zh: 一刺下去，光扎进你袖子。
lines.en: One thrust, and light stabs into your sleeve.
I am not heavy, but my light burns.

lines.zh: 你打碎我一次，我还你一下。
lines.en: You shattered me once; here is my answer.

lines.zh: 你一退，我的黑就跟上去。
lines.en: When you retreat, my black follows after.
My black pressed against your face.
Does it hurt? It hurt when I was struck.

lines.zh: 光散了又聚，别以为完了。
lines.en: The light scatters and regathers; do not think it is over.
I rammed you and staggered myself.
The iron smell on you is unpleasant.
When it is done, I drift back to my place.
One more dim light on the empty ground.
I open my eyes to nothing but grey.
My light is small; I keep it hidden.

lines.zh: 异位的天是灰的，我正喜欢。
lines.en: The Otherside sky is grey, and I like it.

lines.zh: 我试着飞，飞得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: I try to fly and wobble badly.
The infusion stone is growing inside me.

lines.zh: 我从一道裂缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeezed out of a crack in the air.
The light around me keeps drawing back.
Today's black is just the right depth.

lines.zh: 没人欢迎我，我自己来了。
lines.en: No one welcomed me; I came anyway.

lines.zh: 火舌舔过，我的黑焦了一块。
lines.en: A tongue of fire licked me; part of my black is scorched.
I fall, and my light scatters all the way down.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的光熄了一半。
lines.en: Water pours in; half my light goes out.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我被掀出很远。
lines.en: A blast flung me far across the ground.
An arrow pinned straight through my light.
The spell presses down; I cannot move.
My light is spent; I grow thinner and thinner.
Lightning struck — far brighter than I am.

lines.zh: 下面没有光，也没有回声。
lines.en: Below there is no light and no echo.
